cii.title: Emissions & CII
cii.description: Annual Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII) of the fleet: attained against required CII, rating and A–E grade under MARPOL Annex VI regulation 28.

gradeMeaning.E: corrective action plan in the SEEMP required

source.manualHint: Manual / imported record: used because this year has no counted voyage segments.
source.segmentsHint: Computed from AIS voyage segments (telemetry, first formula or Holtrop).

notAvailable.title: No CII data for {{year}} yet
notAvailable.description: There are no counted voyage segments and no manual record for this year. Data appears automatically once the vessel's AIS positions are processed; for past years you can enter a manual record.

vesselNotFound.title: Vessel not found
vesselNotFound.description: The emission service knows no vessel with this MMSI. Check the MMSI or register the vessel in the Vessels module.

forbidden.title: This vessel belongs to another organization
forbidden.description: CII, emission and SEEMP data are private to each organization. Switch to the vessel's organization to see them.

reductionFactorMissing.title: Reduction factor Z not available
reductionFactorMissing.description: The required CII cannot be computed because this year's reduction factor Z is missing. A platform administrator can add it on the Reduction factors Z page.

manualNotFound.title: No manual record yet
manualNotFound.description: This year has no manual or imported record yet.

recomputeRange.title: Invalid recomputation range
recomputeRange.description: The range must be at most 7 days long, end no later than now and lie inside the 7-day stream window.

recomputeInProgress.title: A recomputation is running
recomputeInProgress.description: This vessel is being recomputed. Wait until that job finishes before starting a new one.

superAdminRequired.title: Platform administrators only
superAdminRequired.description: Only platform administrators (super_admin) can do this.

jobNotFound.title: Recomputation job not found
jobNotFound.description: This job is no longer available on the server.

validation.title: Invalid data
validation.description: Check the highlighted fields and try again.

fleet.regulationDescription: This year's reduction factor and the meaning of every grade (MEPC.354(78)).
fleet.actionPlan_one: {{count}} vessel is graded D or E. Grade E, or D for three consecutive years, requires a corrective action plan in SEEMP Part III.
fleet.actionPlan_other: {{count}} vessels are graded D or E. Grade E, or D for three consecutive years, requires a corrective action plan in SEEMP Part III.
fleet.noActionPlan: No vessel is graded D or E this year.
fleet.distributionDescription: Vessels per grade A–E across the organization's whole fleet (all pages).
fleet.tableDescription: Attained against required CII, rating, grade and the trend against the previous year. Select a row to open the vessel.
fleet.tableLabel: CII of the fleet vessels in {{year}}
fleet.notAvailableNote_one: {{count}} vessel has no CII data for this year and is not part of the distribution.
fleet.notAvailableNote_other: {{count}} vessels have no CII data for this year and are not part of the distribution.
fleet.emptyTitle: No vessels in this fleet yet
fleet.emptyDescription: Add vessels in the Vessels module; their CII appears once the first AIS positions are processed.

daily.title: Cumulative CII curve {{year}}
daily.description: Attained CII from 1 January to the end of every day against this year's A–E bands (boundaries dᵢ × required CII).
daily.emptyDescription: The daily curve appears once the first voyage segment of the year is computed.

summary.zMissing: No Z for this year yet
summary.scaleDescription: Grade boundaries = the ship type's d-vector × this year's required CII.
summary.scaleAria: CII rating scale: attained {{attained}} lies in grade {{grade}}. Boundaries A ≤ {{d1}}, B ≤ {{d2}}, C ≤ {{d3}}, D ≤ {{d4}}, above is E.

totals.title: Year-to-date operations
totals.description: Totals of the counted segments in {{year}} and the fuel methods used.

projection.title: Year-end projection
projection.description: Year-to-date totals extrapolated linearly to 31 December.
projection.sameAsYtd: A linear projection scales CO₂ and distance alike, so the projected CII, rating and grade equal the year-to-date values.
projection.none: The projection is only available for the current year computed from voyage segments.

manual.title: Manual / imported CII record
manual.description: Manual annual records (e.g. imported legacy data or DCS reports) are used only for years without voyage segments. Fields left empty are computed by the service.
manual.segmentYearNote: {{year}} has voyage segments: the manual record is stored but not used while segment data exists.
manual.notePlaceholder: E.g. imported 2024 DCS report from the legacy system
manual.computedHint: Leave required CII, rating or grade empty to have them computed from Z and the d-vector.
manual.saveFailed: The manual record could not be saved

annual.title: Annual CII history
annual.description: CII per calendar year from voyage segments, or from the manual / imported record when the year has no segments.
annual.manualNote_one: {{count}} year uses a manual / imported record (marked Manual and hatched).
annual.manualNote_other: {{count}} years use a manual / imported record (marked Manual and hatched).
annual.segmentsNote: Every year is computed from AIS voyage segments.

segments.title: Voyage segments
segments.description: Every segment joins two consecutive AIS positions; fuel is computed by priority telemetry → first formula → Holtrop + weather.
segments.emptyDescription: Pick another range (at most 31 days) or wait for the next AIS positions.
segments.note: "Not counted" segments (gaps > 6 h, no fuel model, invalid results) are not part of the CII.

gap.label: Data gap
gap.hint: More than 360 minutes between the positions; the segment is not counted.

no_fuel_model.label: No fuel model
no_fuel_model.hint: No telemetry, fuel formula or main engine with SFOC.

weather_unavailable.label: Weather unavailable
weather_unavailable.hint: Open-Meteo could not be reached; calm weather (0 kn) was used.

telemetry_reattributed.label: Telemetry re-attributed
telemetry_reattributed.hint: The segment's fuel was replaced by telemetry readings that arrived later.

formula_error.label: Invalid formula
formula_error.hint: The first fuel formula could not be evaluated; the legacy 0.5 L/min was used.

fuel_not_finite.label: Non-finite result
fuel_not_finite.hint: The Holtrop/Kwon model gave a non-finite value (very strong wind on a small hull).

fuel_negative.label: Negative result
fuel_negative.hint: The Holtrop/Kwon model gave negative fuel; the segment is not counted.

dcs.title: IMO DCS-style summary {{year}}
dcs.description: Annual fuel consumption per fuel type, distance, hours under way and CO₂.
dcs.downloadFailed: The CSV could not be downloaded
dcs.disclaimer: This summary holds the core pre-2026 DCS data (fuel, distance, hours under way). It is not an official DCS report: the finer data mandatory from 2026 (MEPC.385(81)) is not included.

recompute.title: Recompute segments
recompute.description: Replays the AIS positions and rebuilds the segments of this range with the current vessel profile, telemetry and weather (at most {{days}} days, inside the 7-day stream window).

issues.order: The start must be before the end.
issues.future: The end must not be in the future.
issues.tooLong: The range is at most {{days}} days.
issues.tooOld: The start must lie within the last {{days}} days (stream window).

recompute.warning: Segments that a complete replay does not produce again are deleted. The action is recorded in the audit log.

errors.VESSEL_CHANGED: The MMSI moved to another vessel during the job

factors.title: Reduction factors Z
factors.description: Annual reduction factors against the 2019 reference line that set the required CII (MEPC.338(76) for 2023–2026, MEPC.400(83) for 2027–2030).
factors.editDescription: Change or add years. Only changed years are sent; other years are kept. Saving republishes every CII.
factors.confirmDescription_one: {{count}} year is updated and every vessel CII is republished with the new factor. The action is recorded in the audit log.
factors.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} years are updated and every vessel CII is republished with the new factors. The action is recorded in the audit log.
factors.saveFailed: The reduction factors could not be saved
factors.emptyDescription: Without Z the required CII cannot be computed. A platform administrator can add them.
factors.chartDescription: Reduction against the 2019 reference line per year, in percent.
factors.howDescription: The required CII of every year shrinks with Z.
factors.howZ: Z(y): reduction factor of year y in percent.
factors.howRef: a × Cap^(−c): reference line of the ship type (MEPC.353(78)) with DWT or GT capacity.
factors.howRepublish: Changing Z recomputes the rating and grade of every vessel for that year.
